defs.def: to say that you will not do sth that sb has asked you to do 拒绝；回绝

ex.s: Those who are dressed inappropriately will be refused permission to participate.
ex.t: 着装不当者将被拒绝参加。

ex.s: Your sister is a good swimmer;surely you will be, too. ”What she refused to acknowledge, however, was that I was visibly afraid of water.
ex.t: 如果有空位，你可以注册。

ex.s: However, some high sugar brands, like Classic Coca Cola, have accepted the sugar tax and are refusing to change for fear of upsetting consumers.
ex.t: 果汁、乳基饮料和大多数酒精饮料免税，年产不足100万升的小型制造企业也免税。

ex.s: It doesn't have anything to do with ignorant optimism when an individual refuses to notice a problem.
ex.t: 这与盲目乐观无关，当一个人拒绝注意到问题时就是盲目乐观。

ex.s: The problem of robocalls has gotten so bad that many people now refuse to pick up calls from numbers they don't know.
（2）Why did the author refuse the help from the man in the house？
ex.t: C．她比那个男人更懂艺术。

ex.s: As the story goes, Lord Macartney refused for his ___34___ to do more than bend their knees.
ex.t: 从那以后，批评家们用"磕头"这个词来形容任何对中国过于顺从的人。

ex.s: She had asked the government for  41  to move the books to a  42  place, but they refused.
ex.t: 她曾请求政府允许把书籍搬到另一个____地方，但被拒绝了。

ex.s: When some refuse vaccination and seek a free ride, immunity breaks down and everyone is in even bigger danger.
ex.t: 每个人都享受疫苗提供的救生益处，但这些益处只有在每个人共同分担风险的前提下才能存在。

ex.s: Those who refuse to take that risk selfishly make others suffer.
ex.t: 麻疹的爆发引起了公众的关注

defs.def: to say that you do not want sth that has been offered to you 推却；回绝

ex.s: I don’t understand why some people refuse to embrace the change.
ex.t: 我不明白为什么有些人拒绝拥抱改变。

ex.s: Becky refuses because she thinks it is better for Jane to 8____________.
ex.t: 贝基拒绝了，因为她认为简最好____________。

ex.s: Nonetheless, Stephen refused to 4_________, and ended up playing college ball for Davidson College.
ex.t: 尽管如此，斯蒂芬拒绝_________，最终为戴维森学院打大学篮球。

ex.s: Many people refused to believe that living things, including humans, had evolved from lower forms of life.
ex.t: 许多人拒绝相信包括人类在内的生物是从低等生命形式进化而来的。

defs.def: to say that you will not allow sth; to say that you will not give or allow sb sth that they want or need 不准许；拒绝给（所需之物）
